name: YVR Airport Park'N Fly Lot
accessInstructions: Enter via 6380 Miller Rd. Follow Evo designated parking signs in Row 3. Tap app to end trip, then board complimentary 24/7 terminal shuttle (departs every 7 minutes).
feeDetails: $5.00 Airport Concession Fee applies to all trip starts/ends.

name: UBC North Parkade (Car-Share Level)
accessInstructions: Enter at 6115 Student Union Blvd. Proceed up to Level 2 designated Evo/Modo bays. No ticket required (automated license plate reader).
feeDetails: No extra drop-off fee. Standard trip rate.

name: UBC Thunderbird Parkade
accessInstructions: Enter at 6085 Thunderbird Blvd. Dedicated car-share stalls located on Ground Level near pedestrian exit.
feeDetails: No extra drop-off fee. Standard trip rate.

name: SFU Burnaby Cornerstone Lot
accessInstructions: Located on University High St near Cornerstone Mews. Designated marked stalls with signage.
feeDetails: No extra drop-off fee. Standard trip rate.

name: Grouse Mountain Base Guest Lot

feeDetails: No extra drop-off fee. Standard trip rate.

name: Cypress Mountain Downhill Base

name: Horseshoe Bay Ferry Satellite Lot
